```{r part1,echo=TRUE}
data("flights", package = "nycflights13")
data("weather", package = "nycflights13")
dim(flights)
dim(weather)

names(flights)
names(weather)

anyDuplicated(weather[c("origin", "time_hour")]) 

flight_data = flights %>%
  left_join(weather, by = c("origin", "time_hour"),
    suffix = c("_flight", "_weather") 
  )

dim(flight_data)
glimpse(flight_data)

write.csv(
  flight_data,
  "flight_data_merged.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


date = as.Date(
  paste(flight_data$year_flight,
        flight_data$month_flight,
        flight_data$day_flight,
        sep = "-")
)

flight_data$day_of_week =
  as.integer(format(date, "%u"))

hour = flight_data$sched_dep_time %/% 100

flight_data$time_period = ifelse(
  hour >= 5 & hour < 12, "Morning",
  ifelse(
    hour >= 12 & hour < 18, "Afternoon",
    ifelse(
      hour >= 18 & hour < 24, "Evening",
      "Night"
    )
  )
)


continuous_vars = c(
  "dep_delay",
  "arr_delay",
  "air_time",
  "distance",
  "temp",
  "dewp",
  "humid",
  "wind_speed",
  "precip",
  "visib",
  "pressure"
)

continuous_data = flight_data[, continuous_vars]


categorical_vars = c(
  "origin",
  "carrier",
  "dest",
  "month_flight",
  "day_of_week",
  "time_period"
)

categorical_data = flight_data[, categorical_vars]
categorical_data[] = lapply(
  categorical_data,
  as.factor
)

str(categorical_data)

flight_analysis = data.frame(
  continuous_data,
  categorical_data
)
dim(flight_analysis);head(flight_analysis);colSums(is.na(flight_analysis))

round(
  colMeans(is.na(flight_analysis)) * 100,
  2
)

```

```{r part3,echo=TRUE}
vars2 = colnames(M)

set.seed(123)

par(xpd = TRUE)
legend("bottom", inset = c(0, -0.42), horiz = TRUE,
       legend = c("Observed", "Missing"),
       fill = c("grey90", "red"), bty = "n")
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, xpd = FALSE)

pressure_group = factor(
  ifelse(is.na(flight_analysis$pressure), "Missing", "Observed"),
  levels = c("Missing", "Observed")
)
table(pressure_group)


compare_vars = c(
  "dep_delay", "arr_delay", "air_time",
  "distance", "temp", "dewp", "humid",
  "wind_speed", "precip", "visib"
)

compare_one = function(v) {
  x = flight_analysis[[v]][pressure_group == "Missing"]
  y = flight_analysis[[v]][pressure_group == "Observed"]
  x = x[!is.na(x)]; y = y[!is.na(y)]
  
  sd_pool = sqrt(((length(x) - 1) * var(x) + (length(y) - 1) * var(y)) /
                   (length(x) + length(y) - 2))
  
  data.frame(
    variable   = v,
    n_missing  = length(x),
    n_observed = length(y),
    mean_miss  = round(mean(x), 2),
    mean_obs   = round(mean(y), 2),
    med_miss   = round(median(x), 2),
    med_obs    = round(median(y), 2),
    SMD        = round((mean(x) - mean(y)) / sd_pool, 3),
    p_wilcox   = signif(wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value, 3)
  )
}


compare_table = do.call(rbind, lapply(compare_vars, compare_one))
print(compare_table)

cat_vars = c("origin", "carrier", "month_flight", "day_of_week", "time_period")

for (v in cat_vars) {
  cat("\n====", v, "====\n")

}

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

  )
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

delay_summary = tapply(

  function(x) {

      Q1 = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR = IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
)

delay_summary

cramers_v = function(x, y) {
  tab = table(x, y)
  as.numeric(sqrt(chisq.test(tab)$statistic / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1))))
}
p_na = is.na(flight_analysis$pressure)
c(origin = cramers_v(flight_analysis$origin, p_na),          
  month  = cramers_v(flight_analysis$month_flight, p_na))

compare_table %>%
  mutate(variable = reorder(variable, abs(SMD))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(SMD, variable)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -0.2, xmax = 0.2, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey92") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = SMD, yend = variable), colour = "#2a78d6", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#2a78d6") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f", SMD)), nudge_y = 0.35, size = 3) +
  labs(x = "SMD (pressure missing - observed)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r part4,echo=TRUE}
dat =flight_data
dat$no_departure     = is.na(dat$dep_time)
dat$pressure_missing = is.na(dat$pressure)

flight_vars  = c("dep_delay", "arr_delay", "air_time", "distance")
weather_vars= c("temp", "dewp", "humid", "wind_speed", "precip", "visib", "pressure")
numeric_vars = c(flight_vars, weather_vars)

core_complete = complete.cases(dat[flight_vars])
analysis_data = dat[!dat$no_departure & core_complete, ]


data_A = analysis_data[complete.cases(analysis_data[numeric_vars]), ]


data_B = analysis_data
for (v in weather_vars) {
  idx <- is.na(analysis_data[[v]])
  data_B[[v]][idx] <- median(analysis_data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
}


month_var = if ("month_flight" %in% names(analysis_data)) "month_flight" else "month"
grp = interaction(analysis_data$origin, analysis_data[[month_var]], drop = TRUE)

p0      = analysis_data$pressure              
grp_med = ave(p0, grp, FUN = function(z) median(z, na.rm = TRUE))
p_miss  = is.na(p0)
n_fallback = sum(p_miss & is.na(grp_med))    
grp_med[is.na(grp_med)] = median(p0, na.rm = TRUE)

data_C = data_B
data_C$pressure[p_miss] = grp_med[p_miss]

c(pressure_imputed = sum(p_miss), fallback = n_fallback)

t_min = min(weather$time_hour)
t_max = max(weather$time_hour)          
 
grid = weather %>%
  select(origin, time_hour, pressure) %>%
  group_by(origin) %>%
  complete(time_hour = seq(t_min, t_max, by = "hour")) %>%
  arrange(origin, time_hour) %>%
  ungroup()
 
nrow(grid)

interp_one = function(t, p) {
  ok = !is.na(p)
  if (sum(ok) < 2) return(rep(NA_real_, length(p)))
  approx(as.numeric(t)[ok], p[ok], xout = as.numeric(t), rule = 1)$y
}

impute_pressure = function(g) {
  site_off = tapply(g$pressure, g$origin, mean, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(g$pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
  g %>%
    group_by(origin) %>%
    mutate(p_int = interp_one(time_hour, pressure)) %>%
    group_by(time_hour) %>%
    mutate(p_other = mean(pressure, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(p_other = ifelse(is.nan(p_other), NA_real_, p_other),
           p_int   = ifelse(is.na(p_int), p_other + site_off[origin], p_int)) %>%
    group_by(origin) %>%
    tidyr::fill(p_int, .direction = "downup") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pull(p_int)
}

grid$p_D = impute_pressure(grid)
sum(is.na(grid$p_D))    

data_D = data_C %>%
  select(-pressure) %>%
  left_join(grid %>% select(origin, time_hour, pressure = p_D),
            by = c("origin", "time_hour"))
stopifnot(nrow(data_D) == nrow(data_C))

after_end = is.na(data_D$pressure)
sum(after_end)
data_D$pressure[after_end] = data_C$pressure[after_end]

c(缺失時段_D補值 = mean(grid$p_D[is.na(grid$pressure)]),
  有觀測時段     = mean(grid$pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
  B_C補上的值約  = median(analysis_data$pressure, na.rm = TRUE))


set.seed(1)
gap_runs = unlist(lapply(split(is.na(grid$pressure), grid$origin),
                         function(z) { r = rle(z); r$lengths[r$values] }))
obs_idx = which(!is.na(grid$pressure))

mask = integer(0)
for (s in sample(obs_idx, 900)) {
  L    = gap_runs[sample.int(length(gap_runs), 1)]
  cand = s:min(s + L - 1, nrow(grid))
  cand = cand[grid$origin[cand] == grid$origin[s] & !is.na(grid$pressure[cand])]
  mask = c(mask, cand)
}
mask  = unique(mask)
truth = grid$pressure[mask]

grid_m = grid
grid_m$pressure[mask] = NA

pred_B = rep(median(grid_m$pressure, na.rm = TRUE), length(mask))
pred_C = ave(grid_m$pressure, grid_m$origin, month(grid_m$time_hour),
             FUN = function(z) median(z, na.rm = TRUE))[mask]
pred_D = impute_pressure(grid_m)[mask]

rmse = function(p) sqrt(mean((p - truth)^2))
mask_result = c(遮蔽筆數 = length(mask),
                B_整體中位數   = rmse(pred_B),
                C_機場月份中位數 = rmse(pred_C),
                D_時間內插     = rmse(pred_D))
round(mask_result, 2) 


strategies = list(A = data_A, B = data_B, C = data_C, D = data_D)  
missing_check = sapply(strategies, function(d) colSums(is.na(d[numeric_vars])))
missing_check
stopifnot(all(missing_check == 0))


summary_strategy = function(d, label) {
  data.frame(
    策略 = label,
    樣本數 = nrow(d),
    抵達延誤平均 = round(mean(d$arr_delay), 2),
    抵達延誤中位數 = round(median(d$arr_delay), 2),
    抵達延誤IQR = round(IQR(d$arr_delay), 2),
    氣壓平均 = round(mean(d$pressure), 2),
    氣壓標準差 = round(sd(d$pressure), 2),
    Pearson = round(cor(d$arr_delay, d$pressure), 4),
    Spearman = round(cor(d$arr_delay, d$pressure, method = "spearman"), 4)
  )
}

comparison_table =rbind(
  summary_strategy(data_A, "A：完整案例"),
  summary_strategy(data_B, "B：整體中位數補值"),
  summary_strategy(data_C, "C：pressure 依機場×月份補值（對照）"),
  summary_strategy(data_D, "D：pressure 時間內插（依機制）")      # 【新增】
)
comparison_table
```

```{r part5,echo=TRUE}
numeric_vars=c("dep_delay", "arr_delay", "air_time", "distance",
                  "temp", "dewp", "humid", "wind_speed",
                  "precip", "visib", "pressure")

pca_list =list(
  A = prcomp(data_A[numeric_vars], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE),
  B = prcomp(data_B[numeric_vars], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE),
  C = prcomp(data_C[numeric_vars], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE),
  D=prcomp(data_D[numeric_vars],center = TRUE,scale. = TRUE)
)
k=5
ref_name = "D"
pca_ref  = pca_list[[ref_name]]
data_ref = strategies[[ref_name]]


round(sapply(data_ref[numeric_vars], sd), 2)    
pca_raw = prcomp(data_ref[numeric_vars], center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
round(100 * pca_raw$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca_raw$sdev^2), 1)  

ev   = pca_ref$sdev^2
prop = ev / sum(ev)
pca_table = data.frame(
  主成分 = paste0("PC", seq_along(ev)),
  特徵值 = round(ev, 3),
  解釋百分比 = round(prop * 100, 2),
  累積百分比 = round(cumsum(prop) * 100, 2)
)
pca_table

k_kaiser = sum(ev > 1)                        
k_80     = which(cumsum(prop) >= 0.80)[1]    
c(Kaiser = k_kaiser, 累積80 = k_80)


ev_all = sapply(pca_list, function(p) p$sdev^2)
matplot(seq_len(nrow(ev_all)), ev_all, type = "b", pch = 19, lty = 1,
        col = c("#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#2a78d6"),
        xlab = "Principal component", ylab = "Eigenvalue", main = "Scree plot (4 strategies)")
abline(h = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey40")         # Kaiser 基準線
legend("topright", legend = names(pca_list), col = c("#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#2a78d6"),
       pch = 19, lty = 1, bty = "n")


var_tab = sapply(pca_list, function(p) round(100 * p$sdev[1:k]^2 / sum(p$sdev^2), 2))
rownames(var_tab) = paste0("PC", 1:k)
var_tab
# ---------- 4. 穩定性:對齊方向後比較權重 ----------
ref = pca_ref$rotation[, 1:k]
align = function(r) {
  s = sign(colSums(r * ref)); s[s == 0] = 1
  sweep(r, 2, s, "*")
}
rot = lapply(pca_list, function(p) align(p$rotation[, 1:k]))

others = setdiff(names(pca_list), ref_name)
stability = data.frame(
  主成分 = paste0("PC", 1:k),
  sapply(others, function(s) round(abs(colSums(pca_list[[s]]$rotation[, 1:k] * ref)), 3)),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(stability)[-1] = paste0(others, "對", ref_name)
stability


cross = lapply(others, function(s) round(abs(t(pca_list[[s]]$rotation[, 1:k]) %*% ref), 2))
names(cross) = others
cross

pc12 = cbind(sapply(rot, function(r) r[, 1]), sapply(rot, function(r) r[, 2]))
colnames(pc12) = paste0(rep(c("PC1_", "PC2_"), each = length(rot)), names(rot))
round(pc12, 3)

round(pca_ref$rotation[, 1:k], 3)                            

load_ref = pca_ref$rotation[, 1:k] %*% diag(pca_ref$sdev[1:k])
colnames(load_ref) = paste0("PC", 1:k)
round(load_ref, 3)
```
